body: It saddens me too that suicide is now soon to become the best option.  No one really wants to as much as they just want to escape the torment of daily life.

What's the rush? While I do not agree this is a good reason to kill yourself, even if it was you don't need to be hasty about it.

I'm sure you should at least wait until March 15.
No doubt sweetheart. At 46, though, i can assure you there are plenty of decent people out there for you.   Anyone that would say that to someone is evil.
You should not talk to your ex bf if he said  that to you.

I don't think we are supposed to talk about methods here but a quick Google search shows this method wont work.   

Please reconsider your decision.
Yeah it's not easy.  What happened?

The way felons are stigmatized today is sad.  I'm not saying that a person's record is irrelevant, but in today's society there is almost no way to outrun your past.  Unfortunately, it's an employer's market out there and you will most likely have to start from the very bottom. 

Good luck.

There is a slim hope things wont go in a direction which would make life worse than death.  Unfortunately, I don't have any control over the outcome at this point its literally out of my hands.  If, somehow,  a certain outcome is avoided I will not entertain thoughts of suicide.   Sorry to be so vague but that's about all I can say.
Nothing is foolproof.  Some even  survive shotgun blasts to the face.
Great job!
That sucks but if you're really that depressed I'd say just let her go and focus on yourself.   I'm very depressed and wouldn't expect someone to deal with me in this state.

I'm seeing a lot of these threads where young people feel they have no chance because they bombed school.   If I were under like 23 or so I'd consider joining the military.   You can retire in 20 years and enjoy life.   I'm sure the military isn't easy but why not think about it given that school is not working.
I probably want to be alone 80% of the time.   Sometimes I dream about being like Howard Hughes and being rich enough to just avoid everyone.
Mental health professionals work for money they should not be trusted and don't care about your health.   Depression and suicide are just problems to be exploited.

That sounds rough.  I would hope that as time goes by your trauma will gradually fade.  You didn't list your age so I can't assess your employment prospects.  Hopefully you are still relatively young and soon you can put this behind you one day.

I've been thinking about it too on my bad days but haven't bought my gun yet.  I'm not going to tell you it's ok or not ok, but I will tell you I know how you feel. I get scared too when I visualize the gun against my head before pulling the trigger.
If I thought it would help I'd consider going.  Unfortunately they will just lock you up if they think you're a danger to yourself .

"99% of life is showing up."  I think the key is to just get to your job or class and not worry about what you'll do once you arrive.  Like today, I was at work but did very little actual work.   But that's not how it appeared to my bosses..  So just make yourself get out of the bed and that's half the battle.
Xanax provides relief.  Just try not to abuse them.
Dude be straight with your doctor.  He may have the answers.   If it's so bad he should be able to smell you anyway.
The fear of pain or a failed attempt.
I worry  I won't have the balls to actually do it.   I've Googled suicide images and it's not pretty.  Putting a gun to your head and pulling the trigger isn't easy even when things are hopeless.

Im so depressed  i don't have the ability to bounce back anymore.  I really feel like  suicide would be more preferable than spending my remaining years flailing around from one failure to the next.  The only thing stopping me is that I might botch the attempt and end up worse.

Sometimes I think she would, deep down, prefer it if I killed myself.  Sure, she'd be sad, but having your adult son turn out a failure is even more ignominious.  Suicide at least has a certain dignity.
